name: anki
description: Push flashcards to Anki via AnkiConnect over Tailscale (Mac at 100.108.20.44:8765).
author: Ove

tools.name: anki_health
tools.description: Check if AnkiConnect is reachable on the Mac.

tools.name: anki_add
tools.description: Add a single flashcard. deck=deck name, front=question, back=answer, tags=comma-separated.

tools.name: anki_quick
tools.description: Quick add using spacing shortcut. Double space between Q and A = don't remember (active card). Single space = remember (suspended). Example: 'What is X  It is Y' (don't remember) vs 'What is X It is Y' (remember).

tools.name: anki_quickbatch
tools.description: Batch quick add, one card per line. Spacing shortcut applies per line. Double space = don't remember, single space = remember (suspended).

tools.name: anki_batch
tools.description: Add multiple cards at once. cards_json = JSON array of {front, back, tags, suspend} objects.

tools.name: anki_import
tools.description: Import cards from a pipe-delimited text file (Question | Answer | Tags).

tools.name: anki_stats
tools.description: Get stats for a specific deck.

tools.name: anki_sync
tools.description: Trigger AnkiWeb sync on the Mac.
